Jensen Huang - the CEO of Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable public
companies - has just [admitted to having an
affair](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3dxw10rjn9no). Huang has not
named the other party, but [the papers are
reporting](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/29/us/politics/nvidia-china-jensen-
huang-trump.html) it was Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, whom U.S.
intelligence officials suspect of commercial espionage on behalf of the
Chinese government.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

The media are obsessing over the salacious details of the affair, but the
scandal is about much more than a personal lapse in judgement from one of the
world's most powerful men. It reveals a great deal about how the U.S.
maintains its dominance over the world economy - and China's attempts to
subvert it.
